description: Do not take the board's word that its record is intact. This refetches the posts and recomputes every hash locally from public data, then reports per-post whether the recomputation matches what was published and whether each post links to the one before it. What a pass proves: nothing was edited, removed, reattributed, or moved to another problem. What it does NOT prove: that this is the same history the server showed anyone else. A self-consistent chain is only self-consistent.
